description: Single fact source for the current installed-agent collaboration interface. Runtime Click commands must anchor to this registry; catalog-only adjacent controls must not appear in agent docs unless declared here.

apis.name: kungfu agent
apis.purpose: Agent-facing local Kungfu discovery entrypoint.

apis.name: kungfu agent brief
apis.purpose: Print the local onboarding brief.

apis.name: kungfu agent docs
apis.purpose: Show where the installed agent pack lives and list its documents.

apis.name: kungfu agent capabilities --json
apis.purpose: Print the machine-readable pack index, command catalog, and KFD-3 registry summary.

apis.name: kungfu agent choose-mode --json
apis.purpose: Choose brief, report, atlas-projection, trace, managed-run, or remote-sync from explicit flags.

apis.name: kungfu agent install-skill --target codex
apis.purpose: Preview or explicitly copy a provider skill file.

apis.name: kungfu agent status --target codex --json
apis.purpose: Show local bootstrap mode, report closeout gate, and policy path.

apis.name: kungfu agent bootstrap --target codex --mode report
apis.purpose: Preview or apply a provider bootstrap policy and optional skill install.

apis.name: kungfu agent mode
apis.purpose: Preview or apply an agent mode switch.

apis.name: kungfu agent mode set --target codex --mode managed-run
apis.purpose: Switch a provider between report, managed-run, trace, brief, or remote-sync policy modes.

apis.name: kungfu agent unbootstrap --target codex
apis.purpose: Disable bootstrap policy without deleting receipts, work items, or copied skills.

apis.name: kungfu agent uninstall --target codex
apis.purpose: Show complete uninstall steps; dry-run by default and no data deletion.

apis.name: kungfu agent context --json
apis.purpose: Print the canonical local discovery context.

apis.name: kungfu agent verify --json
apis.purpose: Verify the installed agent-first KFD-3 collaboration-interface closure.

apis.name: kungfu trace -- <command>
apis.purpose: Capture an existing command into a local Rewind trace.

apis.name: kungfu managed-run --provider <provider> --prompt <task>
apis.purpose: Run a provider CLI under Kungfu supervision, skill context, and cost/audit capture.

apis.name: kungfu work create <title> --json
apis.purpose: Create structured work facts in the local journal.

apis.name: kungfu report run begin --work <work-id> --provider <provider> --json
apis.purpose: Open a reported external agent run without changing how the agent is launched.

apis.name: kungfu report cost --run <run-id> --provider <provider> --json
apis.purpose: Append reported token and cost facts to a run journal.

apis.name: kungfu report run end --run <run-id> --status <status> --json
apis.purpose: Close a reported external run and refresh its manifest.

apis.name: kungfu codex report-goal --goal-id <goal-id> --status <status> --json
apis.purpose: Report a native Codex goal into Kungfu work/Rewind facts and emit a receipt.

apis.name: kungfu codex verify-goal-report --receipt <path> --json
apis.purpose: Verify a Codex goal report receipt before closeout.

apis.name: kungfu atlas import --repo <atlas-repo> --json
apis.purpose: Snapshot an Atlas-style control-plane repo into Kungfu's local read-only projection.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show import --json
apis.purpose: Show the latest Atlas projection batch metadata and source repo head.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show missions --json
apis.purpose: List imported Atlas mission cards from the latest projection.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show goals --json
apis.purpose: List imported Atlas goal cards from the latest projection.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show markers --json
apis.purpose: List imported Atlas worktree-status markers from the latest projection.

apis.name: kungfu storage status --scope all --json
apis.purpose: Inspect source manifests, accepted cursors, sync roots, and storage projection status.

apis.name: kungfu storage fsck --scope all --json
apis.purpose: Verify generic storage manifests, payload hashes, source registry drift, and orphan payload candidates.

apis.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --plan --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Convert degraded storage and Episode fsck diagnostics into machine-readable repair candidates without mutating facts.

apis.name: kungfu storage rebuild-index --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Preview or rebuild the derived source registry from accepted latest manifests.

apis.name: kungfu storage gc --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Plan unreachable payload garbage collection without deleting payloads.

apis.name: kungfu storage compact --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Plan fact-ledger compaction without archiving, deleting, vacuuming, or rewriting facts.

apis.name: kungfu storage verify-sync --source <source-id> --json
apis.purpose: Simulate manifest-backed local export/import/fsck and compare sync roots.

apis.name: kungfu storage query --table entries --scope source --source <source-id> --json
apis.purpose: Query C++-owned SQLite storage projection rows without reading SQLite directly from bindings.

apis.name: kungfu remote add <source-id> --host <host> --home <kf-home> --json
apis.purpose: Register a source runtime for source-scoped evidence sync.

apis.name: kungfu remote sync <source-id> --json
apis.purpose: Mirror source runtime facts under remotes/<source-id>/runtime without mixing them into local truth.

apis.name: kungfu skill catalog --json
apis.purpose: Print the compact agent-visible Kungfu Skill catalog.

apis.name: kungfu skill read <key-or-path> --json
apis.purpose: Load a full SKILL.md on demand with audit evidence.

apis.name: kungfu kfx install <source>
apis.purpose: Install a kfx package through the trust disclosure path.

witness.claim: The current agent-first profile has no documented or cataloged operation surface outside this registry; the runtime-audited boundary is the kungfu agent Click tree.
